**Countercase / boundary:** The task is this explicitly defined glyph orientation, not real digit recognition. No transformation is universally valid across tasks. For a different target “has three pixels in middle row”, both glyphs label Yes and180° rotation is valid.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether copying Up onto the rotated glyph is label-preserving; recall switching the task to the stated middle-row property changes validity without changing pixels.

**Intervention / reachable witness:** Flip/Rotate computes pixels, proposed copied label and task oracle separately. Correct label and Change target expose why validity depends on the target, retaining the invalid rotation witness. Use original code-native cells, no image asset.
